top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a verified, independently confirmed discovery of a new state of matter, defined by a Z2 invariant, with a traceable theory-to-experiment chain (Kane-Mele classification, Molenkamp's HgTe edge conductance near 2e^2/h) and fifteen years of confirmation by transport and spectroscopy. The trio omits Hasan and the Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang proposal, so the credit is imperfect, but the citation scope is defensible and the physics is mature. P002 is a robust, well-defined many-atom advance but its largest consequences are still prospective and it sits close to earlier timekeeping prizes. P003 is a real discovery, but it is outside my expertise and the credit split and independent source confirmation are unsettled. Awarding nothing ranks last because at least three mature candidates exist.
